text:
Elena (People Ops): heads up folks — we've updated the handbook section on performance calibration and conflict-of-interest guidance for calibration panels. This change is to align our review practices with the new audit standard. Managers must review the updated guidance and complete a short calibration attestation by Apr 9. Link: https://intranet.redwood/handbook/perf-calibration :memo:

Mark (Comp & Perf): summary: 1) clarified panel formation rules (no direct reviewers, include at least one cross-functional director), 2) added COI disclosure checkbox + short examples, 3) required 10-min calibration microlearning for any manager participating in a panel.

Jo (Eng Director): quick q — does "participating" mean any panel member or only panel chairs? I sit on a few panels as a cross-functional member.

Elena (People Ops): all panel members must complete the microlearning and sign the COI attestation. Chairs additionally need to complete the 20-min Chair Playbook (best practices + remarking examples).

Samir (HRBP): note on exceptions: if a manager is on extended leave or temporarily unable to complete the training before panel date, they can request a waiver. Waivers must be approved by HRBP + Director and recorded. We'll add a waiver flow in the FAQ.

Mei (Learning): rollout plan: microlearning (10-min) + 4-question immediate quiz (pass 75%). Chairs: separate 20-min playbook. Recordings and transcripts will be available. Live calibration rehearsal slots next week Thu/Fri (3 regional times). RSVP link in the handbook page.

Jo (Eng Director): will there be an automatic check to prevent people from being scheduled on panels without certification? we have tight windows in May.

Elena (People Ops): yes 3 automated check: the panel scheduler will flag unqualified members. If a panel includes unqualified members within 7 days of the panel date, system will email the organizer and HRBP and block finalization until either waiver or certification is recorded.

Mark (Comp & Perf): for audit traceability: we're adding a panel roster export and signed attestations that tie to SSO identities. Retention policy: calibration attestations & rosters retained for 7 years.

Jo (Eng Director): can managers bulk-verify attendance for panels they organized? we've run large comp calibration sessions historically.

Mei (Learning): yes 3 bulk verify via CSV upload. Template and upload path: Manager > Compliance > Panel Certs. Example below.

Mei (Learning): ```csv
organizer_email, panel_id, member_email, member_role, attestation_status, note
jo@redwood.com, panel-2026-05-04-frontend, alex@redwood.com, panel_member, certified, attended rehearsal 2026-04-12
```

Samir (HRBP): matrixed reports: which manager does the COI attestation? any panel member with review influence must attest. If there are conflicting attestations, HR will reconcile. We accept the first valid SSO-signed attestation as the recorded one.

Elena (People Ops): scheduling: initial announcement today, reminder in 4 days, final nudge 72h before panel. We'll run a one-off export on Apr 8 18:00 PT to share with Directors for pre-panel readiness checks.

calendar-bot: :calendar: Live rehearsal slots posted: Thu 09:00 PT, Thu 17:00 CET, Fri 02:00 AET. Add to calendar with: /add_event "Calibration Rehearsal" 2026-04-15 09:00 PT --owner elena@redwood.com

Jo (Eng Director): thanks. Can you drop a manager-sent email template? some leads like to message their teams themselves.

Elena (People Ops): yes 3 sample manager email: ```Subject: Action required: calibration panel attestation + microlearning
Hi team,
We have a calibration panel scheduled for May. Please complete the 10-minute calibration microlearning and sign the COI attestation by Apr 9. If you are chairing, please also complete the 20-minute Chair Playbook. I'll confirm roster after everyone is certified.
Thanks,
<your name>
```

Mei (Learning): note: failing the quiz triggers an automated follow-up offering a 1:1 review. We will report quiz failure rates to Perf team for quality monitoring.

Mark (Comp & Perf): final ask for the doc owners: add two sample COI scenarios to the handbook (family reporting lines; recent hiring influence). That will reduce waiver volume.

Elena (People Ops): adding that to the doc now. Closing ask: managers, please prioritize certification if you're on any May panels. I'll share the Apr 8 export with Directors and HRBPs. Ping me for localized email templates or private rehearsal slots.
